summary.text: Barbara Washington is a Democratic member of the Missouri Senate for District 9, representing southeastern Kansas City and part of Jackson County, first elected in 2020 and re-elected in 2024.

Her official Senate page says she served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and sits on committees including Appropriations and Agriculture, Food Production and Outdoor Resources.

paragraphs.text: According to her Senate biography, Washington is a practicing attorney with a journalism degree from the University of Missouri-Columbia, an MBA from Avila University, and a Juris Doctorate from the University of Missouri-Kansas City.
The page lists her memberships as including the Metropolitan Community College Board of Trustees and Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, and says she is a lifelong Kansas City resident.
